Check repository policy compliance against governance gates (secrets, doc links,
storage boundaries, goroutines, field keys).

  Run all repository policy checks
  zqk system check-policy --all
  Run specific policy check
  zqk system check-policy secrets
  Run multiple policy checks
  zqk system check-policy doc-links storage-boundaries
  Check specific staged files
  zqk system check-policy --files=cmd/zqk/main.go,pkg/storage/file.go

Usage:
  zqk system check-policy [flags]

Aliases:
  check-policy, policy-check, check-repo-policy

Flags:
      --all                     Run all registered policy gates
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --files stringArray       List of files to check (defaults to scanning scope or whole repo)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --scope string            Scope of files to check: 'all', 'staged', or 'working' (default "all")
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
